steps.title: Read the README
steps.body: Start with what the project says about itself, before you read any of its code.

steps.title: Read the contributing guide
steps.body: The repo keeps one. It says how changes are made here and what reviewers look for.

steps.title: Read the code of conduct
steps.body: It sets how people treat each other in issues, reviews and discussions here.

steps.title: Pick a good first issue
steps.body: Issues labeled good first issue or help wanted are the ones maintainers set aside for newcomers.

steps.title: Open a pull request
steps.body: Fill in the pull request template when you open it. Half of new pull requests get a first review within this time.
